## GOVERNMENT OF ANDHRA PRADESH
ABSTRACT

YAT&C (Sps& YS) Department – Sports Policy 2024–29 – Implementation of
three percent (3%) horizontal reservation to eligible meritorious sportspersons of
AndhraPradesh in direct recruitment across Government Departments, Local
Bodies, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) and Uniformed Services including the
Police, Excise and Forest Departments etc– Amendment - Notification - Orders –
Issued.

YOUTH ADVANCEMENT TOURISM & CULTURE(Sps&YS) DEPARTMENT

G.O.Ms.No.23

Dated: 14.05.2026
Read the following:

1. G.O.Ms.No.18 ,YAT & C(Sports & YS) Dept. Dt. 10-12-2024.
2. G.O.Ms.No.4, YAT&C (Sps& YS) Dept., dt. 19-04-2025.
3. From the Vice Chairman & Managing Director, Sports Authority of
4. Andhra Pradesh, Vijayawada Notings in e-file bearing 3245850.

>>><<<

## ORDER:

In the G.O. first read above, the Government of Andhra Pradesh issued
the Sports Policy 2024–29 with the objective of promoting sports development in
the State by creating world-class infrastructure, nurturing sporting talent, and
ensuring inclusive access to sports opportunities. The policy envisions positioning
“SwarnaAndhra Pradesh” as the Nation’s Sports capital and a global hub for
sports excellence and innovation by the year 2029.

1. The policy, inter alia, provides for a three percent (3%) horizontal
2. reservation in direct recruitment across Government Departments, Local Bodies,
3. Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), and Uniformed Services, including Police,
4. Excise, and Forest Departments etc for meritorious sportspersons of Andhra
5. Pradesh. Accordingly, guidelines were issued in the G.O. 2ⁿᵈread above for
6. implementation of the said reservation.
8. During the course of the implementation of the G.O. 2ⁿᵈ read above,
9. certain difficulties have arisen & several representations and grievances have
10. also been received from various sportspersons regarding the operational aspects
11. of the said Government Order.
13. Accordingly, the Vice Chairman and Managing Director, Sports Authority of
14. Andhra Pradesh has submitted proposals for amendment to Clause 6.1 under
15. Approach-6 of G.O.Ms.No.18, YAT&C (Sps.&YS) Department, dated 10-12-2024
16. (Sports Policy 2024-2029) and requested the Government for examination and
17. issuance of necessary orders in the matter.
19. Government after careful examination of the matter, hereby issue the
20. following amendment to Clause 6.1 of G.O.Ms.No.18 Youth Advancement,
21. Tourism & Culture (Sports & Youth Services) Department, dated10-12-2024:-

P.T.O

21. Tourism & Culture (Sports & Youth Services) Department, dated10-12-2024:-

Existing provision in GO Ms No.18
(Sports Policy 2024-29)		 Proposed amendment
(1) (2)
Provision of a 3% horizontal reservation in direct recruitment across Government Departments, Local Bodies, PSUs and Uniform Services such as Police, Excise, and Forest Departments for meritorious and eligible sportspersons.

Provision of 50% of Grade III coaches in SAAP for National/ International Medallists and recruit through the selection board. The Government will constitute a meritorious sportpersons selection board for ensuring direct recruitment without exams.		 “Provision of a 3% horizontal reservation in direct recruitment across Government Departments, Local Bodies, PSUs, and Uniform Services such as Police, Excise, and Forest Departments etc., for meritorious sportspersons, who qualify in the prescribed recruitment examinations conducted by the recruiting agencies.

Provision of 50% of Grade III coaches in SAAP shall be filled by National /International medallists recruited through the selection board."
6.
